project.title: IT request classification with human review

sources.title: Chat request: write a profile for classifying IT requests with human review
sources.summary: The only evidence supplied. No IT procedure, category list, service catalogue, team list, case fields, plan information or country was provided; the request itself states that required context is unavailable.

sections.title: The request
sections.summary: AI classifies IT requests; a human reviews the result.

sections.title: Missing context
sections.summary: Categories, priorities, teams, intake fields, review owner, service levels, plan and country are not supplied.

groups.name: Service desk
groups.purpose: Reviews the AI-proposed classification of IT requests and fulfils them. Proposed by the AI action designer because no source names the reviewing team.

flags.detail: No source names the team or its members; confirm the real group name and membership with IT before setup.

workflows.name: IT request

grants.reason: Assumption: any employee may open an IT request. No source confirms it; see decision D4.

access.note: The service desk receives no view grant: analysts see the cases assigned to them. Whether the desk needs a shared queue of every request is decision D5.

actions.name: Classify the IT request
evidence: missing_information filled whenever something was assumed or absent

actions.name: Confirm the classification of the IT request
evidence: confirmed_category and confirmed_priority filled by the reviewer
Comment required on «Correct» and on «Not an IT request»

folded.summary: Ask the requester for the missing information through case comments when the proposal is unclear (folded into the exceptions of the decision).

actions.name: Fulfil the IT request
evidence: Closing comment addressed to the requester; attachments produced during the work

setupNotes: AI profile: create the profile «Classify IT requests» in Provia (AI settings) with the instructions in ai-profile-classify-it-requests.md, then replace the placeholder $AI_PROFILE_CLASSIFY_IT_REQUESTS in workflow.yaml (actions[0].assignee.id) with the profile id Provia shows. The plugin does not create AI profiles.

AI availability: AI-assigned actions depend on the organisation's plan, the AI settings and the permissions of the signed-in implementer. Confirm in the Provia UI that AI agents can be assigned to Standard actions before importing.

Agent Memory: metadata.agentMemoryEnabled is false. If IT supplies its category list and service catalogue, add them as approved memory documents in Provia and set the flag; YAML never carries memory content.
Reviewer group: create or map the «Service desk» group and set it as owner of review-classification and fulfil; the YAML omits these assignees because no destination id exists.
The fulfil action is a placeholder for the real resolution process; design it with provia-workflow-designer once IT supplies its procedure (decision D6).

aiProfiles.name: Classify IT requests
aiProfiles.purpose: Proposes one category and one priority for each IT request from the requester's own text, with a rationale and a list of missing information; a service desk analyst confirms or corrects every proposal. Instructions, output contract, review behaviour and evaluation cases: ai-profile-classify-it-requests.md.

decisions.question: Which category list does IT actually use? The profile ships a provisional list (incident, service_request, access_request, change_request, information, unclear). Replace it with the organisation's own list before the pilot, or confirm the provisional one.

Which priority scale and impact rules apply? The profile ships a provisional four-level scale (critical, high, medium, low) driven by who is blocked. Confirm the scale, the rules and any service levels per priority.
Who reviews the AI proposal? The design assumes a «Service desk» team. Confirm the real group, its members and whether a second person must confirm critical priorities.
May any employee open an IT request (organization-wide create_incident), or only some groups? The access section assumes any employee.
Does the service desk need to see every IT request (a shared queue, which requires a view grant), or only the cases assigned to its members?
What happens after classification? The fulfil action is a placeholder; the real resolution steps, routing by category and any approvals need the IT procedure.
Service levels: how soon must the AI proposal exist and how soon must the reviewer confirm it? No due is set on any action because no service level was supplied.
Confidence threshold: the profile proposes 0.7 as a starting value so that low-confidence proposals are visibly flagged to the reviewer. Confirm or adjust after the pilot evaluation cases are run.
Country and language: Angola and English were used provisionally because none was supplied. Confirm the country of operation and whether case labels and briefs should be in pt-AO.
